en: Black-and-white postcard showing a tranquil reservoir bordered by trees and gentle hills. Two rowing boats with people are on the lake, while two children and an adult sit on a bench at the right foreground looking over the water. In the distance are forested hills and scattered buildings. The caption at the bottom left reads "Sohland/Spree – Stausee," and a small code "K3160B" appears in the bottom right corner.
